## Info

- Timestamp: 2026-10-14T09:58:27.241Z
- OnlyOffice version: 9.3.0 (build 138)
- Document: spreadsheet.xlsx (cell)
- Scenario:
  1. Alice locks two cell blocks (B3, then D4: cell locks accumulate while she
     is alone).
  2. Bob joins mid-edit: his auth event carries the lock table as a list (empty
     in every record so far).
  3. Bob try on B3 is refused client-side (his editor knows the locks from its
     auth event).
  4. Bob locks and edits D2 instead (his saveChanges, collaborative, releases
     his lock, the relay to Alice carrying its descriptor).
  5. Alice saves collaboratively: her saveChanges releases both her blocks and
     Bob receives their descriptors, leaving B3 free for Bob to lock and edit.
